_doc: CANON of the leak guard's allowlist (design-system scripts/leak-guard): the tapper.ai hosts that are intentionally public. Any other host under tapper.ai found in a public build or a public repo is a hit. `subdomains: true` also allows every host below it. A repo that serves one more public host adds it to its own scripts/leak-guard/leak-allow.local.json (same shape), never here without the same reasoning.
